title: Actual completion unit on a strict K-flat quotient cone
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, a uniformizer $\varpi$ and $A_n=R/\varpi^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For each scheme $W$ under consideration assume $\ell$ invertible on $W$, use its small pro-etale site in the fixed universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention], and put $B_{W,n}=(A_n)_W$ and $\widehat R_W=\lim_n B_{W,n}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

Let $W$ be such a scheme, let $N\in D(\widehat R_W)$, and let $q:Q\to N$ be any flat-term K-flat representative [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Put $Q_n=Q\otimes_{\widehat R_W} B_{W,n}$, $r_n(z)=z\otimes1$ and $\tau_n=1\otimes(B_{W,n+1}\to B_{W,n})$, using the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $\mathscr S_W$ be the strict quotient-semilinear system category on the ringed sequence site [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], let $TQ=(Q_n,\tau_n)$, and let $D=U_W(TQ)$ be its restriction to strict towers of $\widehat R_W$-modules. Write $\mathcal R_W\dashv\mathcal L_W$, $\mathcal L_W=R\lim U_W$, for the canonical simultaneous derived reduction/limit adjunction, with actual unit $u_N$ [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. For a strict tower complex $Z$ put $H(Z)=\operatorname{Cone}(1-s_Z)[-1]$, $s_Z((z_n))=(t_nz_{n+1})$, with coordinates and differential
$$H(Z)^i=(\prod_n Z_n^{i-1})\oplus(\prod_n Z_n^i),\qquad d(b,a)=(-db-(1-s_Z)a,da).$$
Use the normalized Roos identification $\rho_D:H(D)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal L_W\mathcal R_WN$ [lem-weil-strict-roos-comparison].

The strict augmentation $v_Q:Q\to H(D)$, $v_Q(z)=(0,(r_nz)_n)$, is a chain map and satisfies
$$u_N=\rho_D[v_Q][q]^{-1}.$$
This equality is of entire derived morphisms, with zero shifted-product coordinate. More precisely, for any K-injective resolutions with injective terms $a:TQ\to I$ on the ringed sequence site and $j:U_WI\to J$ on its constant-ring tower site [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist], the composite
$$Q\longrightarrow\lim U_WI\xrightarrow{\lim j}\lim J,\qquad z\longmapsto(a_nr_nz)_n\longmapsto(j_na_nr_nz)_n$$
represents the actual unit after $[q]^{-1}$. The first arrow is the ordinary-adjunction transpose of $a$ for $T\dashv\lim U_W$, and the second is the normalized right-derived composition comparison for restriction of rings followed by sequence projection. Under the canonical inclusion $\lim J\to H(J)$ with zero shifted coordinate, this composite equals $H(jU_W(a))v_Q$. The unit formula is independent of all these resolutions and natural for morphisms of $N$ in the derived category. No completeness or boundedness assumption on $N$ is made.
